newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns A-1+ rating to Akademiska Hus loan.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A-1+ rating to Akademiska Hus loan.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it had assigned its A-1+ short-term rating to Swedish Statliga Akademiska Hus AB's $300 million Euro-commercial paper programme with a stable outlook.

Akademiska's double A long-term and A-1+ short-term issuer credit ratings were affirmed. Also affirmed were the K-1/A-1+ Swedish commercial paper programme and the double A five billion crown MTN programme, Standard & Poor's said in a statement.

"The ratings reflect the government ownership, the Swedish state's strong involvement in the higher education sector, Akademiska Hus' domination on the university premises market in Sweden, and the stable customer base," the statement said.
